lines.text: ឃ្លាំងប្រេង
lines.latin: khleang preng (oil depot) ... [brand name, see notes]

notes: Red-and-white kilometre stone (road km 27) by a road near Sihanoukville, pointing to the Sokimex oil depot 7 km away; grass stems cross the text. The Khmer line continues with the brand name Sokimex (4 syllable clusters after ឃ្លាំងប្រេង), but its vowel signs cannot be read reliably through the grass at this resolution, so only the first two words are transcribed. Parked motorbike at right; plate not visible. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: បន្ទាយក្ដី ១៥០ ម
ក្រវ៉ាន់ ១,៥ គ.ម
អង្គរវត្ត ៦,៥ គ.ម
សៀមរាប ១២ គ.ម

notes: Painted stone direction pillar in the Angkor park; target is the front (right) face under the right arrow. Khmer distances use Khmer digits with a comma decimal (១,៥) and គ.ម for km. 'SIEM REAP' is half peeled (only S-EM R..P traces). The subscript in ក្ដី is drawn the same as ្ត; standard spelling with ្ដ used. The left face (Ta Prohm 1 km, Takeo 3 km, Chau Say 3.5 km, Thommanon) is a distractor at an angle.

lines.text: ម្ហូប ម៉ា ម៉ា

notes: Red restaurant fascia, Phnom Penh. Small 'Halal-Food' top-left and 'Est. 1994' bottom-right on the same panel. Khmer line is stylised: the two short words read as ម + musikatoan + aa (ម៉ា); checker should confirm the diacritic. Distractors: grey awning above (Malaysia • Singapore • Indonesia • Brunei, partly cut off), house number 15 at left, small door plate with street number at right, WELCOME signs. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
